module_summary: Destination side of a 4-phase CDC: synchronizes the async request, a 3-state FSM presents data downstream and returns a glitch-filtered registered acknowledge, with optional spill-register decoupling.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: 4-phase handshake state controlling data_valid and acknowledge generation

anchors.name: req_synced
anchors.why: Synchronized async request driving FSM transitions and data_valid

anchors.name: async_ack_o
anchors.why: Registered acknowledge returned across the asynchronous channel

anchors.name: async_req_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous request input fed to the synchronizer

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous data bus captured into spill register or output

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Downstream valid from spill register or data_valid

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready accepting the transferred word

anchors.name: output_ready
anchors.why: Spill-register ready advancing FSM to acknowledge

groups.name: Output decoupling
groups.description: Spill register presenting async data as valid/ready stream
